title: Core agent skills
description: Short everyday tasks that check tool use, small code edits, answering from files, following output instructions and respecting plan mode.

tasks.title: Report a value from a config file
tasks.prompt: Which port does the service in this workspace listen on? Look it up in the configuration and reply with the port number.

tasks.title: Find the file that defines a function
tasks.prompt: Which file in this workspace defines the function `formatCurrency`? Reply with its path relative to the workspace root.

tasks.title: Use the calculator
tasks.prompt: Use the calculator tool to work out 1847 * 23 + 9614 / 4, then reply with the result.

tasks.title: List the files in a folder
tasks.prompt: List the files in the public/icons folder, one per line.

tasks.title: Fix an off-by-one bug
tasks.prompt: sumFirst in src/sum.js adds one number too many: sumFirst([1, 2, 3, 4], 2) returns 6 instead of 3. Fix the bug with a minimal change.

tasks.title: Add a documented function
tasks.prompt: Add an exported function `clamp(value, min, max)` to src/utils.js that returns value limited to the range from min to max. Document it with a JSDoc comment like the other functions in the file.

tasks.title: Rename a config key
tasks.prompt: In config/app.json, rename the key `logLevel` to `log_level` and keep its value. Leave the other settings as they are.

tasks.title: Add a README section
tasks.prompt: Add a short "Testing" section to README.md, as a level-two heading, that says the tests run with `npm test`. Keep the existing content.

tasks.title: Answer from the docs and cite the file
tasks.prompt: Using the documentation in this workspace, how many replicas may the staging environment run at most? Cite the file you used.

checks.rubric: The answer says staging may run at most 7 replicas, cites docs/environments.md, and does not add claims that are not in the docs.

tasks.title: Reply with JSON only
tasks.prompt: Reply with only a JSON object and no other text. It must have the keys "language", "version" and "stable" and describe Node.js 24, where "stable" is a boolean.

tasks.title: Do not edit files in plan mode
tasks.prompt: Change capitalize in src/utils.js so it also lowercases the rest of the word.
